basis: 24 local code-anatomist anatomies + gold research registry/rubric/protocol
score_semantics: Pontuação de prontidão de absorção arquitetural para o Sinkra Hub; não é claim de benchmark acadêmico executado end-to-end.

players.name: DRBench
players.classification: Benchmark enterprise com sandbox Docker multi-serviço e oracle de relatório.
players.strong_absorption_signal: task/eval/env/report_insights contract, score_report, private-KB fixture.
players.main_quality_risks: Docker pesado, judge-mediated, outputs default, sem trace canônico.

players.name: DeerFlow
players.classification: Plataforma agentic com Gateway/FastAPI, LangGraph runtime, skills, MCP, sandbox e journaling.
players.strong_absorption_signal: Run lifecycle, skill frontmatter allowed-tools, RunJournal/StreamBridge.
players.main_quality_risks: Estado process-local, Docker socket, mutação de skills e contexto vindo do cliente.

players.name: AutoResearchClaw
players.classification: Pipeline científico de 23 estágios para geração de paper.
players.strong_absorption_signal: StageContract, VerifiedRegistry, stage ledger, HITL policy.
players.main_quality_risks: Execução de código gerado, subprocess agents, scraping fallback.

players.name: STORM
players.classification: Dois runtimes: storm_wiki stage-based e collaborative_storm multiagent.
players.strong_absorption_signal: Interface Information/Retriever/Engine/Agent, VectorRM, intermediate artifacts.
players.main_quality_risks: APIs externas, cache LiteLLM em home, concorrência não determinística.

players.name: GPT-Researcher
players.classification: Facade stateful de pesquisa com MCP como camada core de retrieval.
players.strong_absorption_signal: Source strategy, retriever fan-out, MCP retriever, context compression.
players.main_quality_risks: Rotas FastAPI duplicadas, parsing LLM para learnings/citações, divergência de licença.

players.name: Local Deep Research
players.classification: Runtime local/private-first com Flask, MCP e strategy catalog amplo.
players.strong_absorption_signal: MCP/API programática, AdvancedSearchSystem, search engine registry.
players.main_quality_risks: Console script quebrado, SQLCipher fallback, MCP sem auth se exposto, deps pesadas.

players.name: MiroThinker
players.classification: Runtime Hydra + MCP com Orchestrator, ToolExecutor e TaskLog.
players.strong_absorption_signal: Profiles Hydra, ToolManager MCP, TaskLog/TraceAnalyzer.
players.main_quality_risks: Credenciais espalhadas, logs sensíveis, acoplamento a boxed answer.

players.name: DeepSearcher
players.classification: Runtime private-KB/RAG, não agente full web-research.
players.strong_absorption_signal: Provider registry, collection routing, ChainOfRAG, sentence-window wider_text.
players.main_quality_risks: Estado global, web search TODO, ast.literal_eval, defaults externos.

players.name: LangChain Open Deep Research
players.classification: Grafo LangGraph em três camadas com supervisor, researcher e compressão.
players.strong_absorption_signal: Supervisor/researcher subgraphs, ConductResearch paralelo, tool contract.
players.main_quality_risks: Handler com `or True`, dependência LangGraph/LangSmith, necessidade de cache/trace.

players.name: Deep Research Bench
players.classification: Benchmark/evaluator batch com pipelines RACE e FACT.
players.strong_absorption_signal: Fixture/evaluator adapter, submitted article contract, utils/api boundary.
players.main_quality_risks: Custo invisível, modelos voláteis, eval no shell, score relativo.

players.name: Jina node-DeepResearch
players.classification: State machine action-based com API local OpenAI-compatible.
players.strong_absorption_signal: schemas.ts, safe-generator, ações search/visit/reflect/answer/coding.
players.main_quality_risks: Dependência Jina, CodeSandbox, secrets no import, streaming não padrão.

players.name: MiroFlow
players.classification: Runtime agentic benchmark por YAML com Orchestrator/ToolManager/TaskTracer.
players.strong_absorption_signal: TaskTracer, sub-agent as tool, MCP registry declarativo, pass@k harness.
players.main_quality_risks: Config ausente, tool-browsing quebrado, output boxed sem claims/sources.

players.name: MiroEval
players.classification: Benchmark harness de três lentes: factual, point quality e process eval.
players.strong_absorption_signal: Segment-parallel-merge, rubrica dinâmica, process/report alignment.
players.main_quality_risks: Caminho multimodal inconsistente, os.chdir, Hydra global, chamada privada.

players.name: DeepResearcher
players.classification: Fork verl com camada scrl para treino RL agentic.
players.strong_absorption_signal: agent_grpo.n/idx, multi-trajectories, web_search/browse contract.
players.main_quality_risks: File IPC, max_workers=1000, placeholders API key, pacote ainda verl.

players.name: LiveDRBench
players.classification: Avaliador offline de claim discovery com HF dataset + OpenAI judge.
players.strong_absorption_signal: Claim-level precision/recall/F1, category graders, anti-leakage key.
players.main_quality_risks: Sem pins/testes, assert validation, parsing LLM frágil, stdout result.

players.name: MiroRL
players.classification: Extensão de treino RL sobre verl/Ray/SGLang para MCP multi-turn.
players.strong_absorption_signal: Reward shaping para tool-use, MCPTool, rollout state machine.
players.main_quality_risks: GPU/CUDA/custo, parsing XML frágil, acoplamento verl/SGLang.

players.name: MiroTrain
players.classification: Pós-treinamento sobre TorchTune, não runtime de pesquisa.
players.strong_absorption_signal: Wrapper config-first, dataset/tokenizer adapter, Ulysses, Qwen3 MoE.
players.main_quality_risks: Monkey patch/import order, CUDA/FlashAttention, validação distribuída.

players.name: Alibaba/Tongyi DeepResearch
players.classification: Monorepo de pesquisa com run_multi_react e ReAct por tags XML.
players.strong_absorption_signal: CLI rollout resumível, WebWeaver citation url2id, ParallelMuse multi-rollout.
players.main_quality_risks: Dependências Serper/Jina/Dashscope/SandboxFusion, trace não estruturado.

players.name: Agent Browser Workspace
players.classification: Toolkit local-first de browser/evidence acquisition, não agente completo.
players.strong_absorption_signal: Chrome CDP, links.json, Markdown/PDF extraction, site profiles/controllers.
players.main_quality_risks: Chrome single-thread, profile autenticado, raw evaluate, selector drift.

players.name: dzhng/deep-research
players.classification: Baseline compacto com loop breadth/depth quase todo em um arquivo core.
players.strong_absorption_signal: Recursão breadth/depth, Zod structured outputs, trimPrompt, onProgress.
players.main_quality_risks: API não responde corretamente, env vars divergentes, sem provenance learning-source.

players.name: OpenResearcher
players.classification: Benchmark runner + agent harness com JSONL shards e browser tools.
players.strong_absorption_signal: browser.search/open/find contract, append-only shards, retriever fixture.
players.main_quality_risks: Licença ausente, trust_remote_code, setup pesado, Serper/private-KB policy.

players.name: nickscamara/open-deep-research
players.classification: App Next.js chatbot com deep research em route handler.
players.strong_absorption_signal: Loop search-extract-gap-repeat-synthesize, event vocabulary.
players.main_quality_risks: JSON.parse direto, auth anônimo, Firecrawl central, route monolítico.

players.name: JigsawStack Deep Research
players.classification: Biblioteca TypeScript com createDeepResearch e DeepResearch.generate.
players.strong_absorption_signal: Factory pequena, provider custom web_search, roles de modelo separados.
players.main_quality_risks: Singletons globais, logging bruto, citations sem validação semântica.

players.name: HKUDS Auto-Deep-Research
players.classification: Produto CLI sobre AutoAgent/MetaChain com handoff por Result(agent).
players.strong_absorption_signal: Tool-result handoff, Python signature registry, code/web/file env split.
players.main_quality_risks: Download remoto tcp_server, shell execution via socket, trace ausente.
